title: Pope Leo has lung cancer, the Vatican announces after surgery
content: Pope Leo XIV had surgery on Tuesday to remove a cancerous growth in his lung, the Vatican announced.

title: What an economics Nobel Prize winner knows about pricing
content: NPR's Ailsa Chang chats with Michael Woodford of Columbia University, who was one of two Americans awarded the Nobel Prize in Economics.

title: Bipartisan group of senators call on Trump to rescind Russian diesel deal
content: Six Democratic and six Republican senators wrote a letter calling on President Trump to withdraw from his recent deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

title: A judge blocks the government's tree-clearing spree at a municipal D.C. golf course
content: Locals and preservationists have long opposed Trump's plan to redevelop a municipal D.C. golf course. That legal fight escalated after the government cleared hundreds of trees on short notice.

title: Cornell University bans frat parties, vows to address 'disturbing' campus culture
content: In a letter, Cornell's president apologized for what happened to the student who alleges she was raped by several men at a fraternity house in 2024 and promised 'meaningful action.'

title: The Trump administration warns Ukraine it could cut off intel, Zelenskyy tells NPR
content: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy sat down for an interview with NPR at a time of renewed tensions with the White House.

title: Writer Yiyun Li lost both of her sons. When words fell short, she turned to music
content: Li won a Pulitzer for her memoir about the suicides of her two sons. In her new novel, Music Against the Night, she writes about two young prodigies in the late 18th and early 19th centuries.

title: Government spent millions on Trump ads. And, federal agents raid Ilhan Omar's home
content: The government is using millions of taxpayers' dollars on pro-Trump ads, even after the president said this would not happen. And, federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's D.C. home.

title: Pakistan imposes emergency rule in former prime minister's stronghold
content: Pakistan has imposed emergency rule in the province governed by the political party of imprisoned former prime minister Imran Khan.

title: What ice cream has to do with this year's Nobel Prize in economics
content: Prices can get sticky. That helps explain why recessions hurt so much — and what policymakers can do about them.
